ammonia.reason: Extensive proteolysis but pH 4.64 protonates NH3 to NH4+, little free ammonia volatilizes.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw ewe milk plus goatskin tulum contact; p-cresol/indole from skin coryneforms and enterococci.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from raw-milk rennet/plasmin proteolysis plus high salt and FFA bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone from fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium roqueforti added.

browning.reason: Lactose depleted and pH 4.64 inhibits Maillard, limited browning despite 38% moisture.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl from LAB citrate metabolism largely reduced to acetoin/butanediol during 4-mo ripening.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very high lipolysis: 750 mg/kg butyric and 625 mg/kg caproic from raw-milk lipase and skin flora.

creaminess.reason: 30% fat with 49% fat-in-dry-matter but acidic demineralized crumbly matrix coats poorly.

crumbliness.reason: pH 4.64 calcium loss plus 4.76% salt and proteolysis fractures casein into short crumbly body.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 38% and high salt with 4-mo drying in permeable skin concentrates casein matrix.

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol 0.76 ug/100g from phenylalanine catabolism by skin yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate up to 23.69 ug/100g from esterification by yeasts/LAB.

goaty.reason: C6-C10 acids from sheep-milk fat: capric 1846 mg/kg, caprylic 733 mg/kg via lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes e.g. 2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism, restrained by acidity.

melt.reason: Low pH demineralization and high salt-in-moisture impair casein flow, softens but does not flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol not detected; limited linoleate oxidation in dry skin-ripened environment.

oil_off.reason: Total free fatty acids 21027 mg/kg and 30% fat release free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make, no smoke-derived phenols like guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: 1.41% titratable acidity as lactic acid, pH 4.64 from prolonged raw-milk LAB fermentation.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata acid-rennet curd with no hot-water kneading, no aligned para-casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd, minimal heat-induced H2S; only trace methionine catabolism to sulfides.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depleted by LAB; high acidity and 4.76% salt suppress sweet perception.

umami.reason: Glutamate released by 4-mo proteolysis of 20% protein, partly masked by very high salt.
